description: Splits one polyphonic cable into sixteen mono outputs, and merges sixteen mono inputs into one polyphonic cable

params.text: Sets the voltage the GATE output carries on channels whose MONO IN jack is patched, -10V to 10V

inputs.text: One channel of the polyphonic CV OUT cable; the output carries as many channels as the highest numbered MONO IN jack in use
The polyphonic cable to be split; its first channel goes to the first MONO OUT jack, its second to the second, and so on
A voltage here sets what the GATE output carries on those channels, in place of the BIAS knob

outputs.text: One channel of the cable patched into CV IN, at 0V when the cable does not reach that channel
The merged polyphonic cable, carrying as many channels as the highest numbered MONO IN jack in use, with 0V on channels whose own jack is empty
A polyphonic cable with as many channels as CV OUT, carrying the BIAS voltage on channels whose MONO IN jack is patched and 0V on the rest

inputs.17:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the BIAS knob's setting.
